chemistry-killer-01.title: Massaning saqlanishi, tarkibning doimiylik qonuni, ekzotermik va endotermik reaksiyalar
chemistry-killer-01.topic: Massaning saqlanishi, tarkibning doimiylik qonuni, ekzotermik va endotermik reaksiyalar
chemistry-killer-01.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
chemistry-killer-01.material:
Mis (Cu) kukuni yopiq idishda kislorod ($\mathrm{O_2}$) bilan reaksiyaga kirishtirilib mis(II) oksid ($\mathrm{CuO}$) hosil qilish tajribasi o‘tkazildi. Barcha tajribalarda idish ichidagi $\mathrm{O_2}$ 2,0 g, reaksiya esa $\mathrm{2Cu + O_2 \rightarrow 2CuO}$. Reaksiyadan keyin hosil bo‘lgan CuO massasi quyidagicha.
(A) Cu 4,0 g → CuO 5,0 g
(B) Cu 8,0 g → CuO 10,0 g
(C) Cu 12,0 g → CuO 10,0 g
O‘zgarmas tarkib qonuni shu sharoitda bajarilganda, shu idishda Cu 14,0 g va $\mathrm{O_2}$ 4,0 g ni reaktivlardan biri to‘liq sarflanguncha reaksiyaga kirishtirilgan natija sifatida to‘g‘risi qaysi?
